English: Camel Post
A makeshift tent post for camel handlers, marking a safe stop for desert travelers and small trade caravans.
Shade Pavilion
Sturdy awnings of woven cloth offer respite from the sun, enticing more merchants and travelers to linger and trade.
Oasis Market
An open area where traders gather under palm shade, exchanging goods and news among the desert folk.
Sand Traders Hut
Simple mud-brick huts for local traders, providing shelter for goods and acting as the first permanent shops.
Caravan Stop
A large, fortified gathering point with guarded pens and wells, offering protection and rest for merchant caravans.
Desert Storehouse
A fortified warehouse built of sun-baked bricks, safeguarding vital supplies and merchant goods from sandstorms and thieves.
Salt Exchange
A bustling hub for the lucrative salt trade, attracting merchants from distant lands and increasing the citys wealth.
Desert Bazaar
A sprawling, covered market of stone and tile, with merchant stalls, storage cellars, and a central auction floor for rare goods.
Dune Market Hall
A grand, fortified market hall of sun-bleached stone, with high towers for watchmen and wide vaults for goods. The heart of desert commerce.
Grand Oasis Caravanserai
A magnificent complex of courtyards, stables, and merchant lodges. The citys crowning jewel, renowned throughout the desert as a center of wealth and safety.
